title: Nine Hours Below Snowline
theme: Staying level-headed when a plan falls apart, sharing hard decisions fairly, and asking for help instead of going it alone
premise: Nine Hours Below Snowline. On a wilderness-skills trip above the timberline, a sudden snow slide traps thirteen-year-old Vale Ortiz, two classmates and their guide below a new wall of snow, with the radio crushed and the temperature dropping fast. Vale has to help the group ration gear, treat a bad sprain, and decide whether to wait for rescue or move before dark.

characters: Vale Ortiz, thirteen, careful and good at noticing small details
Priya Nandan, Vale's classmate, fast on her feet but quick to panic
Tomas Beck, Vale's classmate, strong and steady but stubborn
Mr. Dax Russo, the trip's wilderness guide, who twists his ankle in the slide
facts: The trip is a wilderness-skills elective run by Fernridge Middle School, not a real school
The group was hiking a marked ridge trail above a valley called Snowline Hollow when the slide cut them off from the main path
Their packs hold a stove, one tent, a first-aid kit and three days of food between four people
avoid: violence, gore or anyone being badly hurt

no one dies, gets frostbite, or is left behind on the page; the danger is a problem the group solves together, not a fight or a tragedy
